title: Joining a Gym for the First Time in NZ — What to Expect and How to Choose
meta_desc: Joining a gym in NZ? Learn what to expect, compare prices & choose the best gym for you
intro: Starting a gym journey can be daunting, especially with numerous options available in New Zealand. With weekly membership prices ranging from $15 to $50, it's essential to choose a gym that suits your needs and budget. In this guide, we'll walk you through the process of selecting the perfect gym for your fitness goals.

sections.heading: What to Look for in a Gym
sections.body: When selecting a gym, consider factors such as location, operating hours, equipment variety, and group fitness classes. Popular gyms like Anytime Fitness, with over 50 locations across NZ, and Les Mills, with 12 locations, offer a range of amenities and services.

sections.heading: Trial Passes and Induction Sessions
sections.body: Most gyms offer trial passes or guest passes, allowing you to experience their facilities before committing to a membership. For example, Jetts Fitness provides a 3-day trial pass, while City Fitness offers a free 7-day trial. Induction sessions are also essential, as they help you understand how to use the equipment and create a workout routine.

sections.heading: Best Starter Gyms in NZ
list: Anytime Fitness: 24/7 access, affordable pricing, and a wide range of equipment
Jetts Fitness: No contract options, low prices, and a variety of group fitness classes
Les Mills: High-quality equipment, expert trainers, and a supportive community
City Fitness: State-of-the-art facilities, personalized training programs, and flexible membership options

sections.heading: Getting Started
sections.body: Once you've chosen a gym, it's essential to set realistic fitness goals and create a workout routine. Consider investing in a personal training session to help you get started. Don't oversell yourself on a contract – opt for a flexible membership or a shorter contract term to ensure you're committed to your fitness journey.
